metadata.title: Harborline
metadata.description: Customer support that keeps its word. A support desk with response promises, clear ownership, and live ticket status.

signOutConfirm.title: Sign out of Harborline?
signOutConfirm.body: You'll need to sign in again to get back to your tickets.

hero.title: Customer support that keeps its word.
hero.body: Every ticket gets a response promise, a clear owner, and a status your customer can check without asking.

preview.label: Example ticket as it appears in the agent inbox
preview.subject: Parcel marked delivered but nothing arrived
preview.customerMessage: Tracking says it was delivered yesterday at 2:14pm, but there's nothing at my door or in the mailroom. It's a birthday gift.
preview.note: Checking the courier's GPS scan before I reply, so I can give her a real answer.
preview.draft: Hi Maya, I've opened a trace with the courier and asked for the delivery scan.

submit.title: Submit
submit.body: Customers describe the problem in four short steps and attach a photo or receipt.

track.title: Track
track.body: Replies and status changes land on the ticket as they happen. No refreshing, no chasing.

resolve.title: Resolve
resolve.body: The agent closes the loop, and the whole thread stays on record for next time.

views.title: One ticket, two views
views.body: Customers see the conversation. Agents also see internal notes, the owner, and the response clock. The database decides who sees what, not the interface.
views.customerMessage: My card shows two charges of $86.40 for order HB-38310. I only placed one order.
views.agentReply: Hi Maya, the first payment attempt timed out and was retried. I've voided the duplicate, so it should drop off your statement within 3 to 5 business days.
views.note: Duplicate is a pending authorisation, not a settled charge. Voided in the payments console.

roles.title: Try it from all three sides
roles.body: Each demo account opens a fully stocked workspace, with nothing to set up.
roles.customerTask: Submit a ticket and follow the replies.
roles.agentTask: Work the inbox, reply, and leave internal notes.
roles.adminTask: Review response times and SLA breaches.

footer.note: Harborline is a fictional product, built as a portfolio demo.

signIn.title: Sign in to Harborline
signIn.body: Pick a demo account to explore the customer portal, the agent inbox, or admin analytics.

errors.invalid: That email and password don't match an account. Check both and try again.
errors.generic: Sign in didn't go through. Try again in a moment.

sla.ariaRunning: First response due. {time} left of a {target} target.
sla.ariaOverdue: First response overdue by {time}. Target was {target}.
sla.ariaMet: First reply sent in {time}, within the {target} target.
sla.ariaMissed: First reply sent in {time}, past the {target} target.

states.errorBody: Something went wrong while loading. Try again, and if it keeps happening, sign out and back in.
states.notFoundBody: It may belong to another account, or the link is out of date.

empty.title: No tickets yet
empty.body: If something goes wrong with an order, open a ticket and follow every reply here.

emptyOpen.title: You're all caught up
emptyOpen.body: No open tickets right now. Resolved conversations stay on record in the Resolved tab.

emptyResolved.title: Nothing resolved yet
emptyResolved.body: When a ticket is closed, it moves here with the full conversation.

category.title: What do you need help with?
category.body: Pick the closest match. An agent can change it later.

categoryHints.order_delivery: Tracking, late or missing parcels, address changes
categoryHints.account: Signing in, email changes, saved details

details.title: Tell us what happened
details.subjectHint: A short summary, like: Parcel marked delivered but not received
details.descriptionHint: Include dates, what you expected, and anything you've already tried.
details.orderHint: Starts with HB. It's in your confirmation email.

attachments.title: Add photos or receipts
attachments.body: Optional. Up to 3 files, 10 MB each: PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, PDF or TXT.
attachments.tooMany: You can attach up to 3 files.

review.title: Check and send
review.body: An agent will reply in this ticket. You'll see every update on the ticket page.
review.subject: Subject

errors.subjectShort: Add a subject of at least 3 characters.
errors.descriptionShort: Add a few more details, at least 10 characters.
errors.order: Order numbers are 40 characters or fewer.
errors.generic: Your ticket didn't send. Check your connection and try again.

ticket.created: Ticket sent. Replies will appear here, and the status updates as we work on it.
ticket.uploadFailed: Your ticket was sent, but some files didn't upload. You can mention them in a reply.
ticket.waiting: We're waiting on your reply to keep this moving.

errors.generic: Your reply didn't send. Try again.

ticket.sentBody: We'll reply here, and you'll see the status change as we work on it.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.searchHint: Subject, customer, ticket or order number

empty.title: No tickets match these filters
empty.body: Try another status, or clear the filters to see everything.

select.title: Pick a ticket
select.body: Choose a ticket to read the thread and reply. New customer replies show up here live.

detail.saveError: That change didn't save. Try again.

resolveConfirm.title: Resolve ticket #{id}?
resolveConfirm.body: {name} will see this ticket as resolved. If they reply, it reopens automatically.

composer.noteHint: Only agents and admins see internal notes.

toast.saveErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.

draft.title: Draft with AI
draft.intro: Writes a first draft from similar solved tickets and your team's saved replies. Nothing sends until you press Send.
draft.editLabel: AI draft (you can edit it here or after inserting)
draft.noSources: No close matches in past tickets or saved replies, so this draft only uses the thread.
draft.empty: The model returned an empty draft. Try again.
draft.insertedBody: Read it over and edit before you send.
draft.replaceBody: The reply box already has text in it. Inserting the draft replaces what you wrote.
draft.redraftBody: You changed this draft. Drafting again replaces it with a new one.

summary.title: Summary
summary.intro: {count} messages. Get the gist before you read the whole thread.

errors.unavailable: AI assist isn't available right now. You can still reply as usual.
errors.rateLimited: You've used today's AI assist allowance. It resets at midnight UTC.

analytics.categoryChartLabel: Bar chart of open and resolved tickets per category. Full values are in the table below the chart.
